answer: The defence rests on food bank volunteer tenure with shift rota history: shifts worked at one food bank week after week. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The ripple signal separates the two cases at a glance: Forging 192 of these means building 192 separate rota histories from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. The plume ledger records each payment, the nadir window resets the board, and 192 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
